topic: User creation and synchronization issue resolution
summary_markdown:
A user reported difficulty creating users in the analytics system because they were already created in Modse (an inventory management tool) but did not appear there. The initial attempt to provide a list of emails was made, followed by sharing a link to the AllUnite contacts page.

It was determined that if users exist in Modse, they could be manually entered into the analytics system's contact records. A test confirmed this manual entry method works.

The final resolution involved someone navigating through the existing contacts and populating necessary details (names, roles, passwords) to make them visible within the DSCREEN contacts list.
decisions: Users found in Modse can be manually added/updated in the analytics contact records.
action_items: Someone needs to populate names, roles, and passwords for the users in the AllUnite contacts system.
